name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee
benefit:
**Unit Cost:** ₹1,00,000/per hectare. **Scale of Subsidy:** 50% of the Unit Cost, i.e., ₹50,000/per hectare.
**Release of Subsidy:** In two installments - 1st installment: 60% of the unit cost - 2nd installment: 40% of the unit cost
> **Procedure for Payment of Subsidy to the Grower** The Joint Director (Extn.) / Deputy Director (Extn.) after confirming the admissibility of the clai
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a tribal grower.
1. The applicant's area should be suitable for coffee cultivation as per the opinion of the Coffee Board's officers.
1. The applicant should procure the seed material from the Coffee Board only.
